title: True Vanilla Survival
description: Its main focus is to balance stunning visuals with top-tier technical performance.
body:
## Welcome to True Vanilla Survival
This modpack was carefully assembled to deliver the best possible survival experience in Minecraft 1.21.11, using the lightweight Fabric loader. The main focus is to balance stunning visuals with cutting-edge technical performance.

**What this pack offers:**

Extreme Optimization: Includes the performance trinity (Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore) and optimized chunk generation (C2ME).

Immersive Visuals: Preconfigured shaders (Iris + Complementary Reimagined), lively animations (Fresh Animations), and an infinite horizon (Distant Horizons).

Quality of Life: Inventory management (Mouse Tweaks), visual information tools (AppleSkin, Jade/WTHIT), and native bug fixes.

**Important Notice About Visual Bugs**

We are currently aware of minor graphical inconsistencies in certain shader and render distance combinations. Fixes for some visual bugs will be released in an upcoming update. Thank you for your patience!

## Performance Notice
To improve performance on lower-end computers, we recommend disabling Distant Horizons in the in-game settings or removing the mod from the installation folder.

**Installation**

We recommend allocating at least 4GB of RAM to this modpack due to the use of LOD mods (Distant Horizons) and shaders.
